_comment: A macro whose Samsung value happens to equal alioth's or oplus's cannot be
told apart from an inherited value by comparison alone. Each entry below
pins the reviewed value and the site in the shipped kernel image
that confirms it, so SAMSUNG_IGNORE_COPY can only exempt a value that was
checked. Changes to a pinned value must be re-reviewed here.
A macro may only be exempted while it has an entry here, and every entry
here must also be exempted; tools/verify_samsung_target_profile.py enforces

FAKE_TASK_NORMAL_PRIO_OFF.evidence: set_user_nice reads p->static_prio at [x19,#176] (0xffffff80080fb710); struct task_struct orders prio, static_prio, normal_prio, so normal_prio = 0xb0 + 4

FAKE_TASK_PRIO_OFF.evidence: set_user_nice reads p->static_prio at [x19,#176] = 0xb0 (0xffffff80080fb710) and copy_process writes p->state at [x20,#168] = 0xa8 (0xffffff80080b6610); prio precedes static_prio by 4

FAKE_TASK_USAGE_OFF.evidence: copy_process initialises the task refcount with str w8,[x20,#104] = 0x68 before account_kernel_stack (0xffffff80080b6610)

KMALLOC_PIPE_INDEX.evidence: alloc_pipe_info sizes the pipe ring as n*40 bytes (add x8,x22,x22,lsl#2; lsl x0,x8,#3 at 0xffffff80082e80ac); 16 default buffers = 640 bytes, which kmalloc_index maps to cache index 10

KMALLOC_PIPE_OBJ_SIZE.evidence: alloc_pipe_info allocates the 16-slot ring of 40-byte pipe_buffer entries (0xffffff80082e80ac-0xffffff80082e80b8); 640 bytes rounds up to the 0x400 kmalloc cache
